article.title: Phancy公布Phai-M1影音模型，模型權重仍待開放
article.summary: Phancy公布Phai-A1語言模型及Phai-M1影片生成模型，後者以真人風格影片為重點。
highlights: Phai-M1可在同一流程生成畫面及同步音訊。
公司計劃稍後開放兩款模型的權重，並提供網頁入口供用戶試用。
article.why: 真人風格短片團隊可把影音同步列入模型評估，並按網頁試用和未來權重開放兩種方式安排測試。
article.next_step: 先用同一段人物對白及動作要求記錄網頁輸出，再追蹤權重發布及部署條件，決定是否值得另建製作流程。
article.detail: Phancy表示，Phai-M1針對面部表情、身體動作及真人風格影像訓練，Phai-A1則處理長文及多步驟任務。公司把這些模型接入ModelHub XC等產品及PhanthyMovie應用。製作團隊可分開檢視網頁服務現時能完成的工作，以及權重開放後才可評估的部署選項。
article.title_en: Phancy announces Phai-M1 audiovisual model with weights still planned
article.summary_en: Phancy announced Phai-A1 and Phai-M1, with the video model focused on live-action-style content.
highlights_en: Phai-M1 generates visuals and synchronized audio in one workflow.
Weights remain planned for later release, while a web entry point is offered for trying the models.
article.why_en: Short-form teams can assess synchronization through the web service and treat future weight access as a separate deployment choice.
article.next_step_en: Record outputs for one fixed dialogue and movement brief, then track weight-release and deployment conditions.
article.detail_en: Phancy describes training around expressions, body movement and live-action imagery. A1 handles long text and multi-step work. The models connect to products including ModelHub XC and PhanthyMovie. Evaluate current web tasks separately from deployment options that depend on a later release.
article.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態
